_comment: Project + region come from the Pod's GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION env vars (set by patch-deployment.yaml in your overlay). When model.vertex is omitted here, core-agent's Gemini provider falls back to those env vars at runtime — one source of truth, no sync risk between config.json and the Deployment manifest.

agent.description: Platform agent for managing GKE clusters
agent._auto_continue_comment: Restart-interrupted turns are finished automatically after a pod roll. Since v2.8/#559 this is ON BY DEFAULT for this deployment shape — a headless --no-repl daemon with --session-db — so no auto_continue block is needed to enable it (the daemon logs a one-line notice at boot). Pair with agent.max_turn_cost_usd if unattended spend is a concern; add "auto_continue": { "enabled": false } here to opt out, or freshness / retry_interval to tune. Requires an image built after #559.
